title: cynodon maximus
intro: Cynodon maximus, commonly known as Bermuda grass, is a perennial warm-season grass species native to tropical and subtropical regions. This plant is known for its extensive use in turf and landscaping due to its ability to thrive in various environments. The health benefits of Cynodon maximus include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which have been shown to help reduce inflammation and protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of the plant include its potential to exhibit anti-cancer, anti-bacterial, and anti-fungal properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins.
